This vignette is a working document for RQ1: *how is sentiment distributed
across the text, according to human, lexicon-based and LLM sentiment
analysers?* It compares four word-level lexicons (`afinn`, `bing`, `nrc`,
`syuzhet`) against LLM-based sentiment scores produced by the
`ollama-sentiment-analysis.R` CLI script (see the repo root README for the
HPC/SLURM workflow that generates them).

Human-coded sentiment annotations don't exist yet, so that comparison is
deferred.

## Load and tokenise Aeolus

```{r}
aeolus <- aeolusmicrotexts::load_aeolus()
tidy_aeolus <- tidytext::unnest_tokens(aeolus, word, line)
```

## Lexicon-based sentiment

The four lexicons below are joined **live** at render time via
`tidytext`/`syuzhet` (which in turn pull `afinn`/`nrc` through `textdata`,
prompting for a one-time download/license acceptance on first use) rather
than shipped as static word-sentiment data in this package. This avoids
redistributing the NRC lexicon's word-sentiment mappings, which carry a
non-commercial-use restriction, under this repo's MIT license.

```{r}
afinn_aeolus <- tidy_aeolus |>
  dplyr::left_join(tidytext::get_sentiments("afinn"), by = "word")

bing_aeolus <- tidy_aeolus |>
  dplyr::left_join(tidytext::get_sentiments("bing"), by = "word") |>
  dplyr::mutate(value = dplyr::case_match(
    sentiment,
    "positive" ~ 1,
    "negative" ~ -1
  ))

nrc_aeolus <- tidy_aeolus |>
  dplyr::left_join(tidytext::get_sentiments("nrc"), by = "word", relationship = "many-to-many")

syuzhet_aeolus <- tidy_aeolus |>
  dplyr::left_join(syuzhet::get_sentiment_dictionary(), by = "word")
```

### Total sentiment per microtext

A small helper keeps the four near-identical plots below consistent: total
(signed) and total unsigned (absolute) sentiment score, summed by microtext.

```{r}
plot_sentiment_by_microtext <- function(scored_tbl, value_col, subtitle) {
  ggplot2::ggplot(scored_tbl, ggplot2::aes(x = as.factor(section), weight = {{ value_col }})) +
    ggplot2::geom_bar() +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "Microtext", y = "Total sentiment score", subtitle = subtitle)
}
```

```{r}
plot_sentiment_by_microtext(afinn_aeolus, value, "afinn (signed)")
plot_sentiment_by_microtext(afinn_aeolus, abs(value), "afinn (absolute)")
```

```{r}
plot_sentiment_by_microtext(bing_aeolus, value, "bing (signed)")
plot_sentiment_by_microtext(bing_aeolus, abs(value), "bing (absolute)")
```

```{r}
plot_sentiment_by_microtext(nrc_aeolus, value, "nrc (signed)")
plot_sentiment_by_microtext(nrc_aeolus, abs(value), "nrc (absolute)")
```

```{r}
plot_sentiment_by_microtext(syuzhet_aeolus, value, "syuzhet (signed)")
plot_sentiment_by_microtext(syuzhet_aeolus, abs(value), "syuzhet (absolute)")
```

## LLM-based sentiment (Ollama)

Scored sentence-level CSVs produced by `ollama-sentiment-analysis.R` are
manually reviewed and promoted into `inst/extdata/results/` before this
vignette reads them (see the repo root README's data/results section) —
nothing is read from the top-level, gitignored `results/` scratch directory.

```{r}
results_dir <- system.file("extdata", "results", package = "aeolusmicrotexts")
result_files <- if (nzchar(results_dir)) list.files(results_dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE) else character()

if (length(result_files) == 0) {
  message("No promoted Ollama sentiment results found in inst/extdata/results/ yet.")
} else {
  ollama_sentiment <- purrr::map(result_files, readr::read_csv, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    purrr::set_names(basename(result_files)) |>
    dplyr::bind_rows(.id = "source_file")

  ollama_sentiment |>
    dplyr::group_by(source_file, section) |>
    dplyr::summarise(total_score = sum(sentiment_score), .groups = "drop") |>
    ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = as.factor(section), y = total_score, fill = source_file)) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(position = "dodge") +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "Microtext", y = "Total sentiment score", fill = "Model run")
}
```
